Name: Shemeber
Summary: Shemeber was the king of Zeboiim, one of the cities of the plain that rebelled against Chedorlaomer.
KeyStory: Shemeber's city fell with the other cities of the plain in the battle of the Valley of Siddim.
LifeLesson: Empires rise and fall, but God's promise to Abram outlasted every king of his day.
